messages.author: 91722721526eb1d7
messages.subject: Quick Survey about Geographical Location
parts:
Dear geomorph community,

We are conducting an informal survey to discover where geomorph users are based in the world. We are doing this to understand what geographic areas are represented by our community, which will better help us in providing support and guidance to you all. 

Thank you for assisting us and supporting geomorph!

Please fill in the survey here: https://goo.gl/forms/tA3v3iyP0pEPgYYG3

Regards,

Emma, Dean, Mike and Antigoni,
geomorph team
